A '''New Reborn''' was a member of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] group. They were among the forces [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis|sent]] to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], guarding the [[Chandrila Jedi tomb|tomb]] of the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]. When [[Jaden Korr]] was [[Mission to Chandrila|sent]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], they dueled in the tomb's chamber, where [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Jaden Korr [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="JA" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
The [[New Reborn]] wielded a [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]].<ref name="JA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although clearly being a [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith cultist]] and member of the Disciples of Ragnos, the New Reborn was referred in-game as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], while clearly not being one.<ref name="JA" />
